# Your Daily Briefing — Tuesday 4 August

Yesterday was a solid, controlled effort. Your 5.2km run at 139bpm average shows you're working aerobically without overdoing it, and 10,456 steps rounds out an active day nicely. The honest flag is sleep — 5.8 hours isn't enough to fully cash in on that training stimulus.

The good news is your recovery markers look strong. HRV at 101ms sits right in your 100–118ms baseline, resting HR is an excellent 46bpm, and stress is just 22/100. Your body handled yesterday well. Go ahead with today's planned session as normal — no need to dial back.

With 2,762 calories burned against a 2,300 target, you're in a healthy deficit for your 80–85kg goal. Just make sure you're hitting that 175g protein today — it's your insurance policy for muscle retention while losing weight. Prioritise sleep tonight above everything else.
